name: The Magician VR: The Cursed Wand

reviews.review_title: Unique Wand Spell Casting in VR!
reviews.review_description: When you first start out, you learn a basic attack spell and use it to defeat waves of enemies. Unlocking new spells is the highlight and soon enough you feel like a wizard, making the motions with your wand to attack and defend. My personal favorite is summoning the shield of cards to deflect incoming projectiles. I would love to see Quest Achievements implemented such as - unlock all spells, cast the shield of cards 100 times, etc.

developer_response.body: Thank you so much for the feedback and for sharing your experience. We've noted your achievements for future updates.

reviews.review_description:
There’s something very satisfying about waving a wand around and pretending you know what you’re doing! 😂  Which I don't

A great VR experience that’s fun, immersive and full of magic. its is well polished and leads you gently through the spells you need.  It has taken me a while to select correctly as I get paniky and miss the correct spell, but with time I am sure I will get there.  Enjoying what I have played so far..

developer_response.body: We're so glad you enjoyed it. It's definitely important to stay calm during stressful moments. 😁😁

reviews.review_description:
Decent story line good game play good wand cast
but the ice sleep should be an area damage also from just slowing them

developer_response.body: Thank you very much for the review. We’re really pleased that you like the game. We’ll take your feedback on the ice spell into account for future updates, so that it has some extra effect on enemies or offers some other kind of advantage.

reviews.review_description:
Now I have been looking forward to this game for a while.
It did take a while for me to get to grips with the tutorial only because I didn’t grab the page with the wand direction, once I had it, it was a piece of cake casting the spells.

It very mysterious and spooky, loving the atmosphere of the tunnels. 
So far I’m really enjoying my time , well done devs, 
IT’S MAGIC.

developer_response.body: We are very happy to hear things like this and it encourages us to continue improving and adding things to the project.

reviews.review_description: Really well done, unique mechanics and fun to mess with!
